errors.text_span: Всяка категория е етикетирана с процент в рамките на съответния сектор.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The green sector, which corresponds to the category 'Не се анализира', does not have a percentage value labeled on it.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от оранжевия сектор по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not ordered by descending size. The largest sector is the red one (43.5%), followed by the orange one (41.3%). The clockwise sequence of values from the orange slice is 41.3%, ~6.5% (green), 8.7% (blue), and 43.5% (red), which is not a descending order.

The description fails to report the value of the green sector ('Не се анализира'). While not explicitly labeled on the chart, its value can be calculated as 6.5% (100 - 43.5 - 41.3 - 8.7). The description only vaguely states it 'occupies a small part of the total area'.
